nodes.name: Quy tắc ba điểm
nodes.description: Với ba điểm bất kì A, B, C, ta có AB + BC = AC.

assignments.rationale: Both occurrences describe the same fundamental vector theorem: for any three points A, B, C, the vector sum AB + BC equals AC. The descriptions are mathematically identical despite minor phrasing differences and grade levels (10 vs 12).
